caption: The drawing shows a section of fabric or embroidery featuring a pattern of branches, leaves, flowers, and a small butterfly. The background is a pale cream color. The branches are light brown, crossing horizontally and diagonally across the image. Large leaves attached to the branches are predominantly blue-green with darker blue shading and lighter green edges. There are small green leaves scattered throughout, some attached to the branches and others floating independently. A large, stylized flower in the center has blue-green petals with yellow-green highlights, deep blue interior lines, black stitching details, and a pinkish-red center. Smaller red and pink flower shapes appear near the left and right edges. In the upper right, near the branches, there is a small butterfly with pink and yellow wings. The overall design is framed by a subtle beige border.
title: Jacobean Embroidery
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
